# A02-S21: Working notes

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

Quite interesting that at least one author (Holstein) in a book by Venstre people can actually figure out how to read a theoretical book like Adam Smith's to find out what it says! Of course, we got that point in the 1 semester, but still.

There was quite a bit of small news and small talk at the meeting, and not so many big things except the overwhelming positivity. So I can't really condense it into an email. But maybe we should have a call at the end of next week? Then I'll be done with the PhD application and can probably think a bit more strategically about approaches to use this 'residency'.
